verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only titles of INPI filing pages (trademark, patent, design, e-Soleau deposits), and none of them document starting a filing without an account or entering by file number. The only access-related item, a probe of data.inpi.fr, shows a keyless request denied with HTTP 403 and notes that an account-issued token is required, which points away from keyless entry rather than supporting it.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
